title: sverify quarantine table
description: The rows a node quarantines under on_violation="quarantine" (#184), in a Delta or Iceberg table next to the node's sink. `record` is what each write records: in a Delta commit's commitInfo under the key `sverify.quarantine`, in an Iceberg snapshot's summary under the same key, as JSON text. `row` describes one row of the table. Format 1. Within 1.x the format only gains optional keys and columns, and readers ignore those they do not know (docs/stability.md).

node.description: The stored node whose rows these are.

epoch.description: The node's state the table matches: the sum of `sources`, as the sink's contract record's `epoch`.

sources.description: The version of every source of the node's stage, by name.

source.description: The source's name in the node.

row.description: The row as a JSON object of its columns. Datetimes, dates, times, decimals and bytes are {"$cursor": <type>, "value": <text>}, as the sink's record encodes cursors; NaN and the infinities are {"$cursor": "double", "value": "NaN" | "Infinity" | "-Infinity"}.

copies.description: How many identical copies of the row are quarantined.

conditions.description: The labels of the preconditions the row breaks, as `requires` states them, or the inferred condition's SQL.

reason.description: One line on why, such as "breaks (_.amount >= 0)" or "id = 7 is on 2 rows".

source_version.description: The source version that quarantined the row.

quarantined_at.description: When, in UTC (a timestamp column of the table).

node.description: The node, as in the record.
